image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a brown butterfly resting on a textured, light-colored rocky surface. The butterfly's wings are spread open, displaying a dark brown coloration with distinct orange patches near the wing margins and several small black eyespots (ocelli). The body is dark, fuzzy, and centrally located between the wings. Two long, thin antennae extend from the head.
